subject: Bridge request: keep evaluation live while supplier onboarding finishes
messages:
From: Tom Baker <tom@medisys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:12:00-04:00
Subject: Need a short bridge for the eval while procurement finishes

Hi Kimberly,

Quick situation: procurement at Medisys is behind on supplier onboarding and the PO won't clear until next week at the earliest. The engineering team depends on the sandbox for a live demo to our execs on Aug 11 — if we lose access they'll cancel the slot.

Can Redwood temporarily extend or add evaluation credits for another 10 business days so we can complete the procurement steps without losing momentum? We'll send the PO and signed SOW as soon as procurement confirms. I've attached the draft PO and the SOW for your records.

Appreciate any flexibility — Tom
Tom Baker
Director, Engineering
Medisys Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baker <tom@medisys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Need a short bridge for the eval while procurement finishes

Hi Tom — thanks for the context and for attaching the PO draft.

Short answer: yes, we can help avoid the demo being dropped. Two quick asks so I can expedite internally:
- Confirm the expected PO approval date (even a best-case ETA helps).
- Confirm which sandbox/org id the team is using so we apply credits to the right account.

I'll loop in Ben on approvals; our standard short-term option is a 7-day complimentary voucher applied immediately, with the option to extend another week pending PO receipt. If procurement is certain it will clear by Aug 10, we can greenlight a 14-day runway today conditional on receiving the PO or a formal purchase intent email from procurement.

If you want, I can put a brief note to our sales manager for an expedited one-off approval.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Baker <tom@medisys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:23:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Need a short bridge for the eval while procurement finishes

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 4:05 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Tom — thanks for the context and for attaching the PO draft.
> ...

Thanks, Kimberly. Procurement is being slower than expected — they estimate clearance by Aug 12 (we pushed hard, but it's their backlog). The engineering demo for Aug 11 is still on the calendar and important; if the sandbox goes down on the 6th our execs will want to postpone.

Can you confirm what you can do immediately today? A 7-day voucher would keep things alive through Aug 10 which almost gets us there; if there's any way to get to Aug 14 that would be ideal. We will send a signed intent email from procurement by tomorrow.

Tom

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick bridge for Medisys sandbox

Folks —

I reviewed Tom's request and the attached PO draft. Approve the following temporary support:
- Apply a 7-calendar-day sandbox credit to Medisys account MD-2026-0811 effective immediately.
- If procurement sends a signed intent (procure@medisys.com) by 2026-08-04, escalate to me and I'll authorize an additional 7 days (conditional on receiving PO by 2026-08-12).

Notes: mark the credit as "trial-bridge: manager-approved" in the billing notes and attach the PO draft. This is time-limited — remind customer we'll need PO to continue past the conditional extension.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baker <tom@medisys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Need a short bridge for the eval while procurement finishes

Hi Tom — quick update:
- I've applied a 7-day sandbox credit to your account (MD-2026-0811). That credit is active now and should keep your demo environment live through Aug 10.
- Per Ben's note, if procurement sends a signed intent to procure@medisys.com (cc me) by EOD Aug 4, we can authorize an additional 7 days pending receipt of the PO.

Next steps for you: please send the procurement intent email (even a short note) and confirm the sandbox/org id so I can attach the credit to the correct project. If the PO is delayed beyond Aug 12, we'll re-evaluate but will try to avoid impacting your Aug 11 exec demo.

I've also uploaded the PO draft you sent to our internal deal record: https://hubspot.company/record/MD-2026-0811 for reference.

Let me know if you'd like me to introduce a technical contact internally to help validate the demo environment before the exec meeting.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Medisys_PO_Draft.pdf (application/pdf), SOW_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
